newsitem.title: PERU: Japanese reporters leave Peru siege.
newsitem.headline: Japanese reporters leave Peru siege.

text.p: Two Japanese reporters on Tuesday left the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where Marxist rebels are holding 74 VIP hostages, after spending approximately two hours inside.
The two men, identified by witnesses as working for Asahi TV, were escorted by three police officers to a nearby building occupied by Red Cross officials.
A white car identified by Peruvian television as belonging to police then drew up at the building.
Their visit to the residence, held by the rebels since Dec. 17, was only the second by reporters since the hostage crisis began.
A group of about 20 journalists attended an impromptu news conference by the rebels on New Year's Eve.
